support.B_snippet: GROUP BY partitions rows using the grouping columns.

chunks.text: GROUP BY partitions rows using the grouping columns. COUNT(*) counts result rows, whereas COUNT(column) counts only rows whose column value is non-NULL. After a left outer join, COUNT(*) includes the retained unmatched row; COUNT of a right-side key can represent zero matches. Interpreting grouped counts depends on understanding grouping and NULL semantics. An aggregate condition over groups belongs in HAVING; a row condition applied before grouping belongs in WHERE.
